name: Sons of Santa
source:
Do you want to experience the magic of Christmas all over again? Snowflake, Santa’s not-so-little elf, can show you the way! This cute mini dating-sim game features music, animation, and multiple endings. Try to find them all!

[From [url=https://sonsofsand.itch.io/sonsofsanta2020]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你想再次体验圣诞节的魔力吗？雪花，圣诞老人的小精灵，可以为你指路！这款可爱的迷你约会模拟游戏具有音乐、动画和多个结局。尝试将它们全部找到！

[来自[url=https://sonsofsand.itch.io/sonsofsanta2020]Itch.io[/url]]
